question_options.question: How would you rate this pack?
Which of the three tough guys do you like the most?

labels: No, I'm here for the money.
Meat that's ready to be grilled!
Meat that's going to beat you up!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: So what am I supposed to do?

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: I'm glad you asked...
Ryan and Travis lead Spencer out of the bathroom.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: What you see here before you is what Travis and I have built up over six years of being here...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Wait, how old are you guys?

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: Grr...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: ...Right.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: We control the school.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Being a tough guy on the top of the heap here is exciting. We rake in protection money from the after-school clubs...

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: We steal pencils from kids and sell them back to them for a fee...

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: And on chicken nuggets day, everyone gives us a percentage of their nuggets as, you know, a favor to us.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: This could all be yours one day too, `Spence`... If you do everything Travis and I tell you.
nodes.text_bbcode: This could all be yours one day too, [color=#e23b3b][i]Spence[/i][/color]... If you do everything Travis and I tell you.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Fine. But the name's Spencer, not `Spence.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Fine. But the name's Spencer, not [color=#e23b3b][i]Spence.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Yeah, that's what I said. Now the first thing you have to do... Is get protection money from the clubs.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: I don't think you know what you're saying.
Travis grinds his fist into his palm.

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: Grrr...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I don't need your permission. I can do whatever I want around here.

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: Oh yeah?
Travis punches Spencer, knocking him out!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Unnnghghhhh...
Spencer wakes up again.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: What do you say now?

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: Grr...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: All right, all right. I'll do whatever you want. Just promise me you'll get your gorilla over there off my back.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: That's what I like to hear.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: I like your attitude...

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: But we're not on the same level. You and I don't beat up anyone together. I tell you to find a nerd, you find that nerd, and beat him!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: By yourself.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yeah, yeah...

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Don't disrespect the castle, uh... What's your name?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I'm Spencer.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Don't disrespect the castle, `Spence.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Don't disrespect the castle, [color=#e23b3b][i]Spence.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: I'm Ryan, the brains of this place. This is Travis, the muscle.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: `You're` the brains?
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]You're[/i][/color] the brains?

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: I don't like how you said that.

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: Want me to punch him?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: No, wait! I didn't mean it.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Good. Now see here, `Spence.` We're the `tough guys` here. We kind of rule the school.
nodes.text_bbcode: Good. Now see here, [color=#e23b3b][i]Spence.[/i][/color] We're the [color=#e23b3b][i]tough guys[/i][/color] here. We kind of rule the school.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Normally, we don't just let anyone join our club. But you look like you can handle being one of us. And we could use someone like you.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: You should join us.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: And if I don't?

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: If you don't, and if you beat on the nerds without our permission, you get a taste of Mr. Mighty Righty over here.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: You want to make it here as a one of us, you do what we say. When I say beat up that nerd, you beat him up.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: When I say 'jump', you say 'how high?'

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: And when I say, 'Steal candy from a baby', you say...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What baby?

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Exactly!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: No, I mean, what baby? There are no babies in high school.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: It doesn't matter where the baby comes from. You do it! You get it?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Sounds like I don't really have a choice.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Oh, you always have a choice. What do you say?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Let me go, or I'll punch your face so hard you'll have one more crater in your crater-ridden face!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Ha ha ha!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Travis, lay off. He's telling the truth. This one isn't stupid like a Wilson kid.
Travis lets go of Spencer.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What's the big idea?

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: You must be new here. A couple idiots from Wilson keep coming around to beat up on our nerds and take their lunch money.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Money that's rightfully `ours`. We're trying to put a stop to it.
nodes.text_bbcode: Money that's rightfully [color=#e23b3b][i]ours[/i][/color]. We're trying to put a stop to it.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: We thought you were one of them. But if you're Centerscore...

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: You should still keep your hands to yourself. This school belongs to me and Travis here.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Oh yeah, says who?
Travis holds up his fists.

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: Says 'Mighty Righty' and 'Defty Lefty'...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Gulp! Those fists are huge!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: So are you guys going to beat me up? Is that how this works?

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Normally, yes. But... Are you thinking what I'm thinking, Travis?

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: This kid has some potential. I think he could be going places.

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: Going what places?

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: I'm saying, we take him under our wing.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Uh, that's okay. I...

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Come on. We'll show you the ropes.
Travis and Ryan march Spencer down the hallway and into...

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Welcome to my castle.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Isn't this the boys' bathroom?
Spencer shoves against Travis, pushing him backwards!
Travis punches Spencer!
Spencer goes down.
Later...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Ugh... What happened?
Spencer opens his eyes.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Punched your lights out. We couldn't have you squealing when we dragged you in here.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Where am I?

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Welcome to my castle.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Isn't this the boys' bathroom?

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: Uh, he's staring at me funny... It makes me want to punch him!
Travis punches Spencer!
Spencer goes down.
Later...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Ugh... What happened?
Spencer opens his eyes.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Punched your lights out. We couldn't have you squealing or nothing when we dragged you in here.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Where am I?

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Welcome to my castle.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Isn't this the boys' bathroom?
Spencer walks away only to run into two large boys, Travis and Ryan!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: That was some nice work back there with those nerds. Dex is the best one to give your homework to.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: And stuffing that Ben kid into a trash can? Classic.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: But did you really let the nerd throw garbage at you?

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: And stuffing that Ben kid into his locker? Classic.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: But I can't believe he tore your jacket!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: No kid's gonna respect you if you let them get away with that!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I don't remember asking for advice.
Travis shoves Spencer against a locker!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Hey, I do the shoving!

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: No, `I` do. What do you think you're doing?
nodes.text_bbcode: No, [color=#e23b3b][i]I[/i][/color] do. What do you think you're doing?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What are you talking about?

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: Think you can beat up a nerd around here without us knowing? We can recognize their nasal-y squeals from anywhere on campus!

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: It's another one of those Wilson High toughs, infringing on our turf!
Travis lifts Spencer up by the collar!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Hey, I'm a transfer! I'm a Centerscore student!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: If I don't do something, they're going to beat me up...
Spencer walks up to Erik and shoves him!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Ahhh!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Hey, what do you think you're doing?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Beat it, nerds. If you want to keep your teeth.
Dex and Brendan exchange glances then run away.
Spencer turns to Erik.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Nerd, listen up. You know what you're going to do right now?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Go buy a snack from the snack stand?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: No. You're going to do some homework.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I already did my homework.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You're going to do `my` homework!
nodes.text_bbcode: You're going to do [color=#e23b3b][i]my[/i][/color] homework!

nodes.text: Spencer tosses a sheaf of papers at Erik.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Fill out this stupid homework packet. It's due at the end of the day.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Well, if you need help...
Spencer oversees as Erik fills out the answer sheet.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Last one! The answer to the last problem is Thomas Jefferson and the Declaration of Independence...
Spencer lifts Erik by the collar of his jacket.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: How did you get Thomas Jefferson as an answer? This is math!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Gulp... I never said I got the answers `right`...
nodes.text_bbcode: Gulp... I never said I got the answers [color=#e23b3b][i]right[/i][/color]...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You're either dumb or messing with me... Either gets you a fist!
Erik takes a punch in the gut.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I can fight, you know!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Oh really?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Eep, no!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Then get out of my face!
Erik runs off.
Spencer walks up to Brendan and slaps him upside the head!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Ow!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Hey, it's not nice to hit people!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: That's not going to stop me from hitting you, four-eyes. Now beat it before I take your teeth out.
Erik and Dex exchange glances then run away. Spencer turns to Brendan.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Nerd, listen up. You're doing my homework, or else...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: ...Not this again. Ryan and Travis already tried. Let me tell you, I've been to the other side of town and back again!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Dude, that's a twenty minute walk.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Not when you travel in 15-minute increments and randomly encounter fights!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I learned a couple things in my time... And that's never to back down from a bully!
Brendan winds up and throws a punch into Spencer's gut!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: `Power Punch!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Power Punch![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Spencer doubles over.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Minus 30!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Why'd I say that?!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Want another one? I have four more where that came from.
Humiliated, Spencer staggers away.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Ugh... Where'd a `nerd` learn to punch like `that?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Ugh... Where'd a [color=#e23b3b][i]nerd[/i][/color] learn to punch like [color=#e23b3b][i]that?![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Spencer walks up to Dex and pushes him over.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Ack! Surprise attack!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Hey, what do you think you're doing?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Beat it, nerds. If you want to keep your teeth.
Erik and Brendan exchange glances then run away.
Spencer turns to Dex and hands him a sheaf of papers.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Hey, nerd... You're doing this homework packet for me, or else!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Or else what?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Or else... I'm going to take the metal from your braces and handcuff you to a drinking fountain.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: You'd do that?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Faster than you can wheeze, nerd-face.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Yes, of course, sir, anything, sir. You want your homework done? College-ruled or wide-ruled paper?

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: What else can I do for you? Run your gym laps, write an excused absence in your mom's handwriting, do your dry cleaning?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You do dry cleaning?

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: It's amazing what you can do with a lint roller and a blow dryer.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I'm going to pretend how you're acting is normal...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Forget the lint dryers or whatever. Just do the homework, and get it back to me.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Yes, sir! It'll be done in ten minutes, sir!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: That was easy...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Now... First things first... I need an obedient nerd to do all my homework for me while I ditch class...
Spencer looks around for the nearest nerd and spies a small group across the hall. He overhears them as he approaches.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Hiya, Brendan, did you see the latest `Space 'Splosions` last night?
nodes.text_bbcode: Hiya, Brendan, did you see the latest [color=#e23b3b][i]Space 'Splosions[/i][/color] last night?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Sorry, Erik. I didn't get the chance. I had to go on a quest with my guild.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: What about you, Dex?

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: I had a set of math problems to do.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Scrawny and pathetic... Perfect!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: But which nerd can help me the most with my homework?

nodes.prompt: Which nerd do you want for your homework?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: Which nerd do you want for your homework?

nodes.text: Spencer drags Ben to the trash can.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Not the trash can! Just put me down?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You're seriously ordering me around? You're a nerd. I'm not. You're small. I'm not.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: That means I don't have to listen to what `you` want.
nodes.text_bbcode: That means I don't have to listen to what [color=#e23b3b][i]you[/i][/color] want.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: All I do is what I want, and I want to do `this!`
nodes.text_bbcode: All I do is what I want, and I want to do [color=#e23b3b][i]this![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Spencer shoves Ben into the trash can. But Ben scrambles to get out, spraying trash on both boys!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You idiot! What'd you go and do that for?!
Spencer lifts Ben by the collar and stuffs him back head-first into the trash can!
Spencer drags Ben to his locker.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: No! Not the locker!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Really? But it looks like it's just your size.
Ben rakes at Spencer's jacket. A loud rip echoes through the hallway!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Why you little... Eat metal, brace face!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I don't even `have` braces!
nodes.text_bbcode: I don't even [color=#e23b3b][i]have[/i][/color] braces!

nodes.text: Spencer shoves Ben in and locks it behind him!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Mmph!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Ah, that felt good.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Oh my! That is... Unusual. Well, you have nothing to worry about. I'm certainly not going to reform you.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Mother always used to say, 'Louisa, you can't change what can't be changed. Not every man wants children'.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Uh, okay.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Here's your paperwork and your class schedule. Make sure you try to get along.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Whatever. I'm sure I'll `get along` just fine.
nodes.text_bbcode: Whatever. I'm sure I'll [color=#e23b3b][i]get along[/i][/color] just fine.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Have a nice day!
Spencer leaves the office.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: 'Have a nice day!' Lame.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Nothing `nice` about it. It's just another school day, and this is just another dumb school with more dumb faces to punch in.
nodes.text_bbcode: Nothing [color=#e23b3b][i]nice[/i][/color] about it. It's just another school day, and this is just another dumb school with more dumb faces to punch in.

nodes.text: Spencer begrudgingly heads to his first class.
After class is let out...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Homework already! I hate this school!
Spencer pushes people out of his way.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Ack!

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: Watch it!
Spencer walks up to his locker, but another nerd is blocking his way!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Out of my way, geek!
Ben jumps, dropping all the papers he's holding.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Sorry! I'll get out of your way. Just let me pick up...
Ben scrambles to grab the papers, but Spencer hauls him up by the collar of his shirt.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Please don't hurt me!
Spencer looks from Ben's open locker to the trash can.

options.label: Dump him in a trash can.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I don't listen to anyone, and I do whatever I want. The creeps from Discipline Corp. couldn't touch me. I'm unchangeable.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I've been there for over a year. They're sick of me, and they didn't know what else to do but send me back to school.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I'm unchangeable.
Welcome to another day at Centerscore High! We've seen how the nerds, the popular kids, and rebels survive high school...
Now try seeing if you can survive as one of the tough guys on campus! It's not `that` great, especially when you're the new kid, but...
nodes.text_bbcode: Now try seeing if you can survive as one of the tough guys on campus! It's not [b]that[/b] great, especially when you're the new kid, but...

nodes.text: Can you help Spencer find his place at Centerscore?
Spencer walks into the guidance counselor's office.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You Ms. Lee?

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Why, yes! And you must be Spencer, the new transfer! Welcome to Centerscore. I have your school records here...
Ms. Lee flips through the papers.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Wow, aren't we the busy bee? This is your third school in two years. You transferred from the next city over because you were stuffing other students into trash cans.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You want to read me my whole life story, or can I go?

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Now be patient. Just getting the facts straight. So when Principal Dyre took over your school last year, you were sent to Boot Camp for shoving another kid.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: And after a stint there, you were released last week because Dyre is on trial for accepting bribes.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Delightful! It's always nice to see the reformed ones.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Look, lady, I didn't reform. I'm here because...
Fight Alexei! Duck his punches, jump over his kicks, and take him down when he leaves himself open!
Spencer dodges the punch!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Grrrr!
Alexei's punch connects hard across Spencer's head!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]You...[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Spencer jumps over the kick!

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: What?!
Alexei's kick nails Spencer in the shins!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Ouch!
Spencer punches him in the face!

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: Arrgggh!
Spencer misses!

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: Ha! Fool!
Spencer kicks Alexei hard in the shins!

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: Ow ow ow!
Spencer misses!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What?!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Relax. I got our money. So what's next? Do I get your permission to roam around campus now?

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Whoa, whoa, whoa. Back up there. `Our` money? No, that money belongs to me and Travis.
nodes.text_bbcode: Whoa, whoa, whoa. Back up there. [color=#e23b3b][i]Our[/i][/color] money? No, that money belongs to me and Travis.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Well, that's funny because I collected it...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: So by rights, I should keep it, shouldn't I?

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Are you encroaching on our space?
Ryan turns to Travis.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Is he seriously encroaching on our space?

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: I don't know what that word means, but he looks like a roach to me.

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: And I'm going to `squash` him.
nodes.text_bbcode: And I'm going to [color=#e23b3b][i]squash[/i][/color] him.

nodes.text: Travis takes a swing at Spencer!

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: You'll wish you'd never heard the name Alexei when I'm through with you.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: It's funny, I've never heard it before...

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: Shut up and fight!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Bring it!
The two boys circle each other warily.
Alexei steps forward and jabs Spencer so hard in the appendix, Spencer goes down!

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: Looks like you Lizards are getting more pathetic every year.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Do we have to do everything around here or what?!
Travis swings at Alexei! Alexei ducks out of the way and starts running off.

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: So long, lug nuts!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Oww...

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: What's wrong with you? Get off the floor. You made us look bad out there, Spence.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Please tell me you at least got the money from the clubs...

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Or I'm going to have to beat you up myself...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Take that!
Spencer gives Alexei a right hook that knocks the boy off his feet!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: See if you can handle that!

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: I'm getting out of here!
Alexei runs off.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Um, can I go?
Spencer glares at Ben.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'll go stuff myself in a trash can now...
Spencer turns to Ryan and Travis.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Nice work, new kid.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Now you got all the protection money we asked for?

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: Ha ha! Where'd you get this one, Ryan?

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: Sounds like he's ready for me to bash his face in already.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Wait, that's not what I meant...
Alexei jabs Spencer, who flinches.

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: I don't care what you meant...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I'm going to punch you so hard, everyone will call you Soup Face!
Spencer jabs at Alexei who jumps back!

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: Hey, I wasn't ready! Remember this, lame brain...

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: What's wrong with this guy? So dumb, he can't even remember his own name?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Hey! I meant to say...
Alexei jabs Spencer, who flinches.

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: I don't care what you meant...
Spencer is on his way back to the boys' bathroom to meet up with Ryan and Travis...
When he sees another bully threatening a nerd!

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: Give me your lunch money, punk, and I won't punch your face in.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Trust me when I say I'm tired of being bullied around today.
Alexei winds his fist back.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Punch that nerd, and you're dead, Alexei!
Ryan and Travis come running up.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I never thought I'd look forward to seeing Ryan and Travis.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Look, Alexei, this is Centerscore turf, which means it's `our` turf.
nodes.text_bbcode: Look, Alexei, this is Centerscore turf, which means it's [color=#e23b3b][i]our[/i][/color] turf.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: That means these nerds are `our` nerds! Don't mess with them!
nodes.text_bbcode: That means these nerds are [color=#e23b3b][i]our[/i][/color] nerds! Don't mess with them!

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: You reasoned that out yourself, huh, Ryan?

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Yeah! It makes total sense! Which means `you` have to stay away!
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah! It makes total sense! Which means [color=#e23b3b][i]you[/i][/color] have to stay away!

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: Oh yeah, and what are you going to do about it?
Ryan turns to Spencer.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Spence, take care of this guy!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Why don't you do it?

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: Grrr...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I'm not Ryan's watchdog, but if it'll get these two chumps off my back...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Fine.
Spencer walks forward and cracks his knuckles.

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: What's this? New meat?

options.label: Meat that's ready to be grilled!
Meat that's going to beat you up!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: The show's not going to go on without an audience, is it?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: And the school's not going to be happy if they don't get money from the ticket sales.

nodes.speaker: Mona
nodes.text: You won't be happy either when we can't pay you.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: No sweat off my back. If the theater club goes down, another club will go up in its place.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: And we will offer the same protection to that club.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: But what's going to happen to you?

nodes.speaker: Mona
nodes.text: I won't be able to perform...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Exactly.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Don't underestimate what I can do. A fire alarm pulled at the right moment could take theater club down.

nodes.speaker: Mona
nodes.text: That's just fighting dirty.

nodes.speaker: Mona
nodes.text: But here's your money. It's your cut from the budget increase of last year.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Nice doing business with you...

nodes.speaker: Mona
nodes.text: You want to destroy all the theater equipment? Be my guest!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You don't care about that stuff at all?

nodes.speaker: Mona
nodes.text: Look for yourself. All our stage equipment is here.
Mona sweeps her hand across the empty stage.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Is this a trick? There's nothing there...

nodes.speaker: Mona
nodes.text: That is entirely my point, darling. This is the improv group... We don't need props.

nodes.speaker: Mona
nodes.text: And even if you did destroy our props, we can always make new ones...

nodes.speaker: Mona
nodes.text: Or improvise with the ruined ones! We don't throw things away here...

nodes.speaker: Mona
nodes.text: Now why don't you take your oafish countenance somewhere else.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: So I won't destroy your set. But you still need to pay up...

nodes.speaker: Mona
nodes.text: Or else what? You'll beat me up? I'm a girl.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I'll think of something!

nodes.speaker: Mona
nodes.text: Be sure not to come back when you do...
Spencer storms out of the theater...
In the auditorium, Spencer finds one actress practicing on stage.

nodes.speaker: Mona
nodes.text: Alas, long heart, for your happiness, I wouldst turn the world away from the face of the sun...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You there! I'm looking for the theater group.
Mona stops to glare at Spencer.

nodes.speaker: Mona
nodes.text: Excuse me, this is a closed session. You can't be in here.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I'm here on business. Where's the theater club?

nodes.speaker: Mona
nodes.text: Right here. It's just me today. I'm practicing.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: How do you practice with just one person?

nodes.speaker: Mona
nodes.text: I play all the parts. Now what business are you here for?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I'm here for Ryan and Travis. It's payday.

nodes.speaker: Mona
nodes.text: Oh, you're the jester for those fools. Tell them I won't pay.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Won't or can't?

nodes.speaker: Mona
nodes.text: Does it matter?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I'm not a messenger. I'm here to collect.
Spencer holds up the beaker and smashes it on the floor!

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: The beaker!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You're underfunded... You can't afford more supplies. It would suck, wouldn't it, if you kept losing equipment?
Spencer knocks over something else. It falls to the floor and cracks.

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: Wait, stop! Not the graduated cylinder!
Spencer knocks over more glassware.

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: Not the petri dishes! Bacteria grows there!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Eww...

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: That's the point! You would never understand... No more damage, please. I'll pay.
From the trashcan, Ben protests...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Ashley, don't do it.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Shut up, nerd, or I'll stuff you so far in, you'll be known as Garbage `Ben` your entire life.
nodes.text_bbcode: Shut up, nerd, or I'll stuff you so far in, you'll be known as Garbage [color=#e23b3b][i]Ben[/i][/color] your entire life.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Gulp!

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: Here. A whole five bucks. Have fun, you pig.
Spencer leaves.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Let's stir up some drama in the theater department...
Spencer holds up the beaker.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: This looks pretty important.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What happens if I do this?
Spencer picks up another beaker with liquid in it.

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: No, wait!
Spencer mixes the two beakers! The liquids mix and...
Nothing happens.

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: Ha ha ha!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What's the big idea?

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: Congratulations. You've just made salt water.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Then these two chemicals are junk?!

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: Not junk... Just distilled water and sodium chloride.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Laugh it up now. You probably won't laugh when I do this!
Spencer throws the beaker to the floor... But it's caught by Ben!

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: How did you do that?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Trust me, I've had a lot of practice catching falling beakers.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Now I think it's time for you to go...
Ben hurls a ball of paper at Spencer.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What is this? Trash?
Ashley and Ben begin to pelt trash at Spencer! Spencer runs out!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Well, that was embarrassing... I hope the theater goes better...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Nice try, Jessica, but you're not fooling me.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You're hot, I get it, but you're not going to make me forget about the payment that easily.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Hand over the money, or I'm going to do something you're going to regret.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Like what?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I've dealt with your type before. If you don't pay me, I'm going to take care of your mascot. What is it, Lyle the Lizard?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: You're going to feed and water him?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: No! I'm going to get rid of him. You'll never see him again!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Oh no! You're not going to take Lyle's head again, are you?
Amanda buries her head in Hector's chest.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: We've been over this before... The head is `supposed` to come off.
nodes.text_bbcode: We've been over this before... The head is [color=#e23b3b][i]supposed[/i][/color] to come off.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Whatever. If you don't pay, your mascot is going to.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: No!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Ugh, fine. I'll hand over the money.
Jessica tosses Spencer a couple bills from her wallet.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Here's a cut of the money from concession stands and bake sales.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Nice doing business with you.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: By the way, if you are free after the game, maybe we could...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Not a chance, creep. Get out of here.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Now for chemistry club...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I'm not going to miss the chance to see you. Friday night, it is...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Tee hee... Good.
Jessica kisses Spencer on the cheek!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I'll be sure to look for you in the stands!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I'll look for `you` in the stands!
nodes.text_bbcode: I'll look for [color=#e23b3b][i]you[/i][/color] in the stands!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: That's not where I'm going to be, silly. But that's sweet.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: See you then!
Jessica, Hector, and Amanda walk off.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: That is one hot girl...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Now, all I have to do is return to Ryan and Travis and...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: The money!
Spencer looks around, but Jessica and the other cheerleaders are gone.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: She played me! Ugh, I don't know what I'm going to say to Ryan and Travis...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: But there are the other clubs... The chemistry geeks had better be easy to push over!
In the chemistry lab, Ashley and Ben work diligently on a new formula...

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: About ten grams of sodium chloride... And there! This will be it, Ben!
Ashley holds up a beaker of liquid, which Spencer immediately grabs as he walks in.

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: Hey! Be careful with that! I need it! Give it back! What are you doing?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Grabbing your attention. We need to talk.

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: Talk? I don't even know who you are.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I do. You're the guy that beat me up this morning!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: And it's time to do it again.
Spencer pushes Ben back! Ben stumbles, tripping over a chair and falling into a large garbage bin.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Eww... This one's full of the dissected frogs from biology class!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Ha ha ha!

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: What do you want?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I'm Spencer, and I'm here to collect money from you.

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: You're kidding, right? I'm not paying you.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What if I said I was coming instead of Ryan and Travis?

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: Then I'd say, leave us alone, we don't have any funding. If you'd wait a couple weeks for the science fair... We'd make money then, and you could have a cut.

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: Right now, it'd have to come out of my pocket. And I can't give you much...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: It's not about the amount, it's about the respect. Just give us a small share, or I'm going to...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Great...
Jessica gives Spencer her number.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I just got a hot cheerleader's number...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: So will I see you Friday?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I'd like my money right now.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Yeah, yeah, I'll get it to you, but...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I can't believe you don't want my number...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I didn't say that...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: So you are still interested? Will I see you Friday?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Uh... Can I get your number?
Jessica gives Spencer her number.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I just got a hot cheerleader's number...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: So will I see you Friday?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Actually, I don't have something going on Friday night.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: That's great! Because the other cheerleaders and I are going to a game that night.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: And I'm sure it'll be really awesome if you came and watched us cheer.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: What do you think? Should I give you my number?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Hand over the payment. Then we can talk about Friday.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: This money talk is starting to bore me...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: But I notice you didn't say you were `busy` on Friday...
nodes.text_bbcode: But I notice you didn't say you were [color=#3b78e2][i]busy[/i][/color] on Friday...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Because the other cheerleaders and I are going to a game that night.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: And I'm sure it'll be really awesome if you came and watched us cheer.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: That does sound fun...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: What do you think? Should I give you my number?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Uh... Uh...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Sounds like whatever else you have isn't that important.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: And that's great! Because the other cheerleaders and I are going to a game that night.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: And I'm sure it'll be really awesome if you came and watched us cheer.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: What do you think? Should I give you my number?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I'm not here to pose for you. I'm here about Ryan and Travis' money.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: What money?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: The protection money you promised them?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Oh, of course... It's just...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You are so cute... Hey, what are you doing on Friday?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Of course!
Spencer flexes.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: That is so hot. You look so fit! I bet you could lift me!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Easily.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Hey, what are you doing on Friday night?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Uh... Uh...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: What's the matter? Shy?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: No, of course not!
Spencer flexes.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: That is so hot. You look so fit! I bet you could lift me!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Easily.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Hey, what are you doing on Friday night?

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: We worked out a system with the students where if they pay us, we don't bother them.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: And things here at Centerscore run smoothly when people pay out.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: But we haven't been getting all our payments. There are some clubs that are behind on what they owe.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: There are three groups you need to get money from: the cheerleaders, the chemistry club, and the improv theater group.

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: Those clubs haven't paid us in over two weeks.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: We need you to go get the money.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: How am I supposed to do that?

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Do what we do best... Give them an offer they can't say 'no' to! You understand?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yeah. Got it.
Spencer walks to where Jessica, Amanda, and Hector are carrying supplies.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Hey, got a minute to talk?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Sorry, we have practice, and Taylor's going to kill us if we don't get her these supplies `right now.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Sorry, we have practice, and Taylor's going to kill us if we don't get her these supplies [color=#e23b3b][i]right now.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I wasn't really asking.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Who are you?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I'm Spencer. And it's pay day. I'm here to collect for Ryan and...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Spencer? Oh! I'm Jessica. Are you new?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yeah, it's my first day.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I knew I hadn't seen your handsome face before.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Uh, thanks!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Wow, this chick is really into me...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: But I have to focus on getting the money...
Jessica touches Spencer's bicep.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: So, like, do you work out? You look really ripped in that shirt...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I like to lift weights on occasion...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Ooh! Will you flex for me?

options.label: No, I'm here for the money.

nodes.text: Spencer side steps around Travis and knocks his fist against Travis's temple!
Travis looks dazed but recovers.

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: I'm going to wipe that smart grin off your face!
Travis lumbers towards Spencer and swings again!
Spencer dodges and knocks Travis in the head on the same spot! Travis goes down!

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: Unnghghh...

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: I don't want to fight, but you left me no choice.
Ryan rolls up his sleeves and jumps into the fray, opening with a right hook aimed at Spencer's head!
Spencer dodges, then kicks Ryan! Ryan trips backwards into a trash can!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: `Ha!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Ha![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Spencer kicks the trash can over, and Ryan rolls hard to the ground.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: I give up! I give up!
Great, but not quite `perfect.` Try again to unlock the bonus scene!
nodes.text_bbcode: Great, but not quite [b]perfect.[/b] Try again to unlock the bonus scene!

nodes.text: And don't forget to join us on facebook.com/survivinghighschool to tell us what you thought of this episode and discuss SHS with other fans!
Spencer takes Travis' blow to the head and stumbles back!

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: Want some more of this, punk?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: No more! I'll give your money back to you...

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Step down, Travis..
Ryan comes up to Spencer, draws his fist back, and punches Spencer in the gut!
Spencer steps away from Ryan.

nodes.speaker: Mona
nodes.text: Gasp!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: The new guy beat up Ryan and Travis!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You're done, Ryan and Travis. I don't need your permission to wander the school halls anymore.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I'll be taking all the money and all your businesses now.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: What are you talking about? We built all that up ourselves!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I'm not a chump. You two were using me to get payments out of everyone else because you two are all washed up.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What's the matter? You got beaten up by your nerds a few times? Or maybe you've been around so long, no one's scared of you anymore...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: But that changes now. I'm taking your place. I'll get my protection money, and the pencil business, `and` the cutlets on chicken nuggets day!
nodes.text_bbcode: But that changes now. I'm taking your place. I'll get my protection money, and the pencil business, [color=#e23b3b][i]and[/i][/color] the cutlets on chicken nuggets day!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Maybe I'll give you permission to operate... If you work for me...
Ryan and Travis exchange looks.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Hail, Spencer, head of the tough guys!

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: To Spencer, head of the tough guys!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: That's right. From now on, I'm Spencer the Pain Dispenser!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: This is going to be a `great` year...
nodes.text_bbcode: This is going to be a [color=#e23b3b][i]great[/i][/color] year...

nodes.text: He may not be the best role-model, but Spencer the Pain Dispenser is the new head tough guy!
Way to punch it! You helped Spencer fit right in at Centerscore High!
You played a smashingly great game!
Spencer ducks!
Around them, a crowd starts to form...

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: Fight! There's a fight!

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: Whoa, look at that! The new kid's beating up Travis!

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: I'm not going to let these guys take me down again!

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: Not after they've been making me run around all day doing their dirty work for them!

args.text: Thanks for playing! See you in another episode!

nodes.text: And Spencer goes down!

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: Take that, punk!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Don't try to rise above where you are!
Ryan snatches Spencer's wallet.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: And one other thing...

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: You're not one of us. If I see or hear about you beating up on any of the nerds without our permission...

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Travis is going to knock your teeth so far back, your stomach will have cavities!
Ryan and Travis walk away.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Unhgh....

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We should go help him!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Don't be nice, $ZOE. He's been going around threatening different clubs and putting people in trash cans all day...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah, you're probably right.
The crowd disperses, leaving Spencer alone on the concrete...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I don't have the protection money anymore, and no one else at the school is going to help...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Heck, I can't even get kicked out for picking on another kid unless I want to get pummeled by Travis and Ryan again!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What am I going to do now?
And a week later, Spencer is helping out in chemistry lab...

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: So if we stir this into this aqueous acidic mixture...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: We should be able to neutralize the bases!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Hey, um, guys?

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: What is it, Spencer?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I'm, um, done with stocking the stock room. Can I help mix stuff now?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Come on, Spencer, I told you. You're going have to make up for what you've done to the nerds if you want to start hanging out with us.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: And that means alphabetizing all the chemistry reference books and personal journals...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: And don't forget that all the beakers need to be thoroughly washed and dried for lab class tomorrow.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I understand! I'm on it! Right away!
Spencer went from being the punching bag of the bullies to being the lackeys of the nerds?!
Well, this is hardly the triumphant end that Spencer would've wanted...
Try again and help Spencer find a way to get things done for Ryan and Travis!
And don't forget to join us on facebook.com/survivinghighschool to tell us what you thought of this episode and discuss SHS with other fans!

args.text: Try again! We know you can do it!

nodes.text: And Spencer goes down!

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: Take that, punk!
Ryan is about to snatch the money from Spencer's wallet when Ben steps out from the crowd!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Stop right there, Ryan.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: What are you saying, punk? You want to get into a fight? Because I'll take you on right now!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I don't want to fight you, but we're all sick of how you, Travis, and the new guy have been treating us.
Jessica and some of the cheerleaders step forward.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Yeah, we don't want to give you money that `we` earned.
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, we don't want to give you money that [color=#3b78e2][i]we[/i][/color] earned.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Listen, sweetheart, this is for your own protection. It's `protection` money...
nodes.text_bbcode: Listen, sweetheart, this is for your own protection. It's [color=#e23b3b][i]protection[/i][/color] money...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yeah, it's protection from you!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: But we worked hard to get that funding. And we don't appreciate it when you send your goon to come around and collect it from us every two weeks.
The students from the theater group also edge in closer.

nodes.speaker: Mona
nodes.text: Hector's right. The theater club won't tolerate being threatened anymore.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: No more threats!

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: No more paying!

nodes.speaker: Mona
nodes.text: No more threats!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: No more paying!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: No more taking Lyle heads!
The crowd closes in on Ryan, Travis, and Spencer!

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: Gack!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Wait, stay away from me!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Stay back! Stay back! I'll beat you up!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You can't take all of us down!
And with that, the crowd descends on the three boys!

nodes.text: And Spencer goes down!

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: Take that, punk!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Don't try to rise above where you are!
Ryan snatches Spencer's wallet.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: And one other thing...

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: You're not one of us. If I see or hear about you beating up on any of the nerds without our permission...

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Travis is going to knock your teeth so far back, your stomach will have cavities!
Ryan and Travis walk away.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Unhgh....

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We should go help him!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Don't be nice, $ZOE. He's been going around threatening different clubs and putting people in trash cans all day...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah, you're probably right.
The crowd disperses, leaving Spencer alone on the concrete...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I don't have the protection money anymore, and no one else at the school is going to help...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Heck, I can't even get kicked out for picking on another kid unless I want to get pummeled by Travis and Ryan again!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What am I going to do now?
And a week later, Spencer is helping out in chemistry lab...

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: So if we stir this into this aqueous acidic mixture...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: We should be able to neutralize the bases!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Hey, um, guys?

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: What is it, Spencer?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I'm, um, done with stocking the stock room. Can I help mix stuff now?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Come on, Spencer, I told you. You're going have to make up for what you've done to the nerds if you want to start hanging out with us.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: And that means alphabetizing all the chemistry reference books and personal journals...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: And don't forget that all the beakers need to be thoroughly washed and dried for lab class tomorrow.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I understand! I'm on it! Right away!
Spencer went from being the punching bag of the bullies to being the lackeys of the nerds?!
Well, this is hardly the triumphant end that Spencer would've wanted...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Stop right there, Ryan.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: What are you saying, punk? You want to get into a fight? Because I'll take you on right now!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I don't want to fight you, but we're all sick of how you, Travis, and the new guy have been treating us.
Jessica and some of the cheerleaders step forward.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Yeah, we don't want to give you money that `we` earned.
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, we don't want to give you money that [color=#3b78e2][i]we[/i][/color] earned.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Listen, sweetheart, this is for your own protection. It's `protection` money...
nodes.text_bbcode: Listen, sweetheart, this is for your own protection. It's [color=#e23b3b][i]protection[/i][/color] money...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yeah, it's protection from you!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: But we worked hard to get that funding. And we don't appreciate it when you send your goon to come around and collect it from us every two weeks.
The students from the theater group also edge in closer.

nodes.speaker: Mona

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yeah... About that... The clubs didn't exactly pay up...

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Are you telling me you didn't get us our money?
Ryan turns to Travis.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Did he seriously just tell us he didn't get us our money?

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: You are not going to enjoy this...
Travis winds up!

In fact, you were `perfect!` Enjoy this special bonus scene!

nodes.text: What do the tough guys do now that Spencer is king?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: If we're going to run this place correctly, we're going to have to keep better tabs on everyone in the school.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: That starts with knowing exactly who everyone is.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Starting with the bottom of the totem pole.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: What you're saying is that we're going to rate the nerds.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Got a problem, Ryan?

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: No! Of course not... It's just that's what the cheerleaders do with boys...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: The cheerleaders do this to figure out who they're dating. We're doing this to figure out who we can use.

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: Can we do the hot girls next?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Sure. But for now... Nerds!
The door opens, and Erik, Dex, and Brendan stream in holding posterboard.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Nerds, present yourselves. Name, rank, all that.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I'm Brendan Berg. And I still don't get why we're here...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You're explaining why Travis, Ryan, and I shouldn't punch your lights out every day for the rest of your natural high school life.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I pack a powerful punch?
Spencer nods at Ryan. Ryan punches Brendan.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Ouch! That hurts!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Power punches don't work if you're on the floor!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Cough... Cough... Sorry. Brendan Berg. I can provide you computer services and information on popular girls.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You can stay. Next!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Erik Ericson, sir. I'm a nerd of the sci fi variety. I enjoy `Space 'Splosions` and Quasar Battles and...
nodes.text_bbcode: Erik Ericson, sir. I'm a nerd of the sci fi variety. I enjoy [color=#e23b3b][i]Space 'Splosions[/i][/color] and Quasar Battles and...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: This isn't speed dating. I don't care about your interests or your hobbies.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Why are you useful to us?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I know how to fight nerdy?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Nope.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I, um... I can run?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Nope...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I'm friends with Colt?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Who's Colt?

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: He's one of the other wise guys who's beating up people on our turf...

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: I mean, `your` turf!
nodes.text_bbcode: I mean, [color=#e23b3b][i]your[/i][/color] turf!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: And we haven't taken him down?

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: He's tough. And he's got an in with the popular girls. It'd look bad to do anything to him.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: So what you're telling me, Erik, is that you can ask Colt to do stuff for us?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Well, sure!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: All right, Erik. We won't beat you up for now... But at some point in the future, you'll have to do us that favor.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Next?

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Dexter Albright, sir. I...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Ah, you're the one that volunteered to clean my room, do my laundry, and get my homework done. You can stay.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: And for our next order of business... Rating the girls at school!
Looks like the tough guys are busy thanks to Spencer!
